text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
They're handing back the quizzes for all 
our subjects today. Feeling confident, 
Class Rep?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I checked over it multiple times 
before submitting, so I think I might get 
a perfect score!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, calculation error. I made careless 
mistakes in this subject too...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Not a single full score, huh. And here I 
thought I had it this time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Weighed down by her poor quiz results, 
Narita Top Road couldn't get into the 
groove for the rest of her training 
either.
